BinDay - a Windows disk cleaner
===============================

WHAT IT IS
  BinDay looks for things your PC does not need any more: build output,
  dependency folders, package caches, temporary files, old installers,
  duplicate files, oversized videos and photos, leftover app packages and
  redundant copies of the same installer. It shows you every item with the
  size it takes up and a plain explanation of what would happen if you
  removed it. Nothing is deleted until you tick it and confirm.

INSTALL
  1. Unzip this folder anywhere (Desktop is fine).
  2. Double click Install.bat.
  3. BinDay appears on your Desktop and in the Start Menu.

  No admin rights. Nothing is installed outside your user profile.

UNINSTALL
  Double click Uninstall.bat.

FIRST RUN
  The folder to scan is pre-filled with your user profile. Change it if you
  want to scan a project folder instead, then press Scan.

  - Pick a collection on the left (Dev junk, Caches, Videos, App packages,
    Redundant installs and so on) or stay on "All items".
  - Switch between large cards, a compact list and a sortable details table
    with the buttons on the right.
  - Click an item to read exactly what it is, what would happen if you
    removed it, and how to get it back.
  - Tick the items you want gone (the tick box on the card, the Space key, or
    "Tick for cleanup" in the panel on the right).
  - Choose "Recycle Bin" or "Delete permanently", then press the big button
    and check the review screen.
  - Only items marked Safe can be deleted permanently. Everything else is
    refused on purpose.
  - "Cleanup history" in the ... menu shows what was removed in the past and
    how much space that freed.

ALSO WORKS FROM THE COMMAND LINE
  BinDay.exe "C:\path\to\folder"
  scans that folder as soon as the window opens.

REQUIREMENTS
  Windows 10 (1903 or newer) or Windows 11.
  .NET Framework 4.8 ships with those versions of Windows.

NOTES
  - Items moved to the Recycle Bin still use disk space until you empty it.
  - Cleanup history is written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\BinDay\history.jsonl.
  - Errors are written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\BinDay\error.log.
  - Your view and sort choices are remembered in %LOCALAPPDATA%\BinDay\ui.txt.
